Customer Success Manager - Wrenfield Digital

About the role
Wrenfield sells booking software to independent hotels and wants a customer success manager for its larger accounts. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Own relationships with key accounts
- Drive adoption and renewals
- Report customer health to leadership

Requirements
- Customer onboarding
- Renewals and account expansion
- Churn analysis
- CRM tools
- Executive presentations

Nice to have
- SQL

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
